author of \'Mrs.

Twitch\'

\'Mrs.

Twitch\' was a story, signed R. L. C., published in MP (June 1869) 606-12, which gave rise to a query answered in (October 1869) 415.

Two later stories, also about Mrs Twitch and presumably by the same author, were \'Pin-Baskets\' (June 1875) 639-646, and \'True and Just in All My Dealings\' (September 1881) 300-3. \'St.

Canace\'s Jackdaw\' was a poem, published in MP (August 1869) 140-1.

The other stories mentioned in CMY\'s letter to Mrs Curteis have not been traced.
